newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-GIANTS' KENT, CUBS' HOUSTON SUSPENDED.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-GIANTS' KENT, CUBS' HOUSTON SUSPENDED.

text.p: The National League Friday suspended San Francisco Giants second baseman Jeff Kent and Chicago Cubs catcher Tyler Houston for their role in initiating a bench-clearing brawl on August 13th.

Kent, who pulled Houston's mask off after being hit by a pitch from Jeremi Gonzalez, received a three-game suspension and was fined an undisclosed amount. His suspension takes effect Monday, but he has the right to appeal. Kent is batting .256 with 23 homers and 93 RBI.
Houston received a two-game suspension and also was fined an undisclosed amount. His suspension takes effect Tuesday. Houston is batting .234 with one homer and 21 RBI.
